hook: Beta... bhookhe ko khana pahunchane mein der mat karna...
feedback: Great hook and strong atmospheric tension tailored specifically for modern Indian audiences (monsoon Mumbai chawl + delivery driver theme). To hit absolute perfection: 1) Add 2 more rapid silent cuts (e.g., close-up of sweating hand on lift metal, flickering light indicator) during the lift pause to hit your 14-16 cut target. 2) Ensure Rohan's line in Cut 11 strictly mixes simple natural script smoothly without sudden theatricality. Overall, highly effective reel screenplay.
lines: Beta... bhookhe ko khana pahunchane mein der mat karna...
Raat 3:15 AM par... band floor par lift achanak ruk gayi!
Girgaon ki nabbe saal purani chawl mein Aarav der raat delivery karne pahuncha tha.
Aakhri food parcel dene wo paanchwein floor ki jaali wali lift mein chadha.
Par lift chauthe floor par me ruk gayi... jo saal 1994 ki aag ke baad band tha!
Andhere se ek boolha aadmi andar aaya... hath mein brass tiffin liye.
Paanchwein floor par Aarav kaampte hue customer Rohan ke pas pahuncha.
Rohan ne kaampte hathon se deewar par tangi purani photo dikhai...
Ye mere dadaji hain... 1994 mein tiffin deliver karte hue jal gaye the!
Aaj raat agar purani lift 3:15 AM par ruk jaye... toh brass tiffin mat lena!
